name: atlas-slack
description: Full Slack Web API access via MCP - generic gateway for all 200+ methods plus slack_download for file bytes. Structural errors, unread state, args echo, files.uploadV2 via the SDK, bot auto-split, _raw flag, Slack transcripts. v2 core: policy engine, provenance (comm_id minted by the door), 30-min one-time decisions bound to the exact operation, SQLite write-ahead journal, reconciliation of unknown outcomes, Door library, profiles; the six message sends (post, schedule, update, ephemeral, me, upload) through the core (contract v1.9).
